title: Sourcing advisor
subtitle: Why an order went to its store, and what the cheapest on-time store would have cost. Read-only: routing is never changed from here.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the sourcing advisor
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

lookup.label: Delivery number
lookup.hint: Enter a delivered order to see why it went to its store.

load.failedTitle: The explanation could not be loaded
load.failed: Something went wrong reading this order. Try again in a moment.

refusal.noGrant: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor grant.
refusal.badRange: The range is at most 92 days, and its start comes before its end.
refusal.notScored: Order {{orderNo}} is not found, or has not been scored yet. Orders are scored the night after they are delivered.
refusal.notScoredRange: Scoring has not run for part of this range yet.

placeholder.title: Placeholder rates
placeholder.body: These SAR figures use placeholder rates until finance supplies the real ones. Do not quote them.

saving.heading: The saving
saving.none: No cheaper on-time store: there is no saving to show.

reasons.heading: Why they differ
reasons.nearerStoreStocked: A nearer store had the stock and was on time.
reasons.actualLate: The store that filled it would have been late.
reasons.avoidableSplit: The order was split when one store had every line.
reasons.expressPremium: The express premium made the actual store dearer.
reasons.cheaperFleet: A cheaper courier fleet served the cheapest store.
reasons.actualWasBest: The store that filled it was already the cheapest on time.
reasons.stockEstimated: Some stock is estimated from current stock, not recorded at order time.

candidates.heading: Candidates
candidates.count: Up to 15 stores that could have filled it, as scored.
candidates.empty: No candidates on record for this order.

problem.incomplete: Pick both ends of the range.
problem.reversed: The range starts after it ends.
problem.tooLong: The range is at most <max>{{max}}</max> days.

scoredThrough.title: Scored through <v>{{date}}</v>
scoredThrough.body: The nightly job has not scored the rest of this range yet, so its later days are not counted.

top.heading: Biggest savings
top.hint: Up to 50 orders with the biggest estimated saving. Open one to see why.
top.empty: No order in this range had a cheaper on-time store.
